title: Sr Embedded Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Job description Job Title: Embedded Software Engineer Experience: 5+ Years Location: Bangalore (Work from Office) About the Role We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Engineer with a strong background in industrial electronics and embedded systems development. The ideal candidate should be passionate about building reliable, high-performance embedded solutions and have hands-on experience working with Linux-based embedded platforms. Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for industrial electronic products.
- Develop and optimize embedded applications using C and C++.
- Work on Embedded Linux platforms, including customization and integration.
- Build and maintain Linux distributions using Yocto Project.
- Debug, test, and optimize embedded firmware and software.
- Collaborate with hardware, QA, and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle. Required Skills
- 5+ years of experience in embedded software development.
- Strong background in the Industrial Electronics domain.
- Hands-on experience with embedded systems development.
- Strong programming skills in C and C++.
- Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto.
- Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

title: ETL Tester
jobDescription: Job Description: ETL Tester Quality Assurance Position: ETL Tester Experience: 3 – 5 Years Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Work From Office) About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented ETL Tester with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in testing data warehousing and ETL pipelines. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating data extraction, transformation, and loading processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and integrity across systems. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scripts based on business and technical requirements Validate data movement from source to target systems across various stages of the ETL pipeline Perform source-to-target data mapping and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and consistency Write and execute complex SQL queries to validate data transformations, aggregations, and business rules Identify, log, and track defects using tools like JIRA, and work closely with development teams for resolution Perform data quality checks including completeness, correctness, duplication, and referential integrity validation Validate ETL jobs built using tools such as Informatica, Talend, SSIS, Data Stage, or similar Conduct regression testing after ETL code changes or enhancements Test data warehouse/BI reports for accuracy against underlying data sources Prepare test summary reports and maintain test documentation (test cases, defect logs, RTM) Collaborate with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, and Developers to understand requirements and mapping documents Support UAT and assist business users during validation cycles Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field 3–5 years of experience in ETL/Data Warehouse testing Strong proficiency in SQL (complex joins, aggregations, subqueries) Hands-on experience with ETL tools (Informatica / Talend / SSIS / Data Stage / Ab Initio – any one or more) Experience testing on relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, or similar) Good understanding of Data Warehousing concepts (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact & Dimension tables, SCDs) Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (JIRA, HP ALM, Test Rail, etc.) Familiarity with Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting (preferred) Exposure to BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) for report validation is a plus Knowledge of Python or automation scripting for data validation is an added advantage Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Work Details Location: Noida (Work From Office – 5 days a week)

title: Business Intelligence & Dashboard Developer
jobDescription: JOB DESCRIPTION Business Intelligence & Dashboard Developer GCP | Looker | Big Query Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site) Experience 3 – 5 Years Employment Type Full-Time Function Business Intelligence / Analytics Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on BI & Dashboard Developer with strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Looker, and Big Query. The ideal candidate will design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards and data models that empower stakeholders with actionable insights. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, and requires someone who can translate complex datasets into clean, intuitive visualizations — similar to a Business Intelligence Analyst / BI Developer profile. Key Responsibilities Dashboard Development & Reporting Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports using Looker / Looker Studio. Build and optimize data models using Look ML to support self-serve analytics. Collaborate with business teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable BI solutions. Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant, and aligned with business KPIs. Big Query & Data Modelling Write complex SQL queries and stored procedures in Big Query for data extraction and transformation. Design efficient data models (star/snowflake schemas) for reporting layers. Optimize query performance and manage Big Query datasets, tables, and partitions. Work with raw data sources to build clean, aggregated reporting tables. GCP Integration Leverage GCP services — Big Query, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub — for end-to-end data pipelines. Integrate Looker with GCP data sources for seamless, real-time analytics. Support deployment and management of BI workloads on GCP infrastructure. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with product, operations, and leadership teams to define metrics and reporting needs. Conduct data validation and sanity checks to ensure report accuracy. Document data definitions, dashboard logic, and Look ML models. Present findings and dashboard walkthroughs to non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications Must Have 3–5 years of hands-on experience in BI development / data analytics roles. Proficiency in Looker / Looker Studio — dashboards, explores, and Look ML. Strong SQL skills with hands-on Big Query experience (views, CTEs, partitioning, clustering). Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — Big Query, GCS, IAM, etc. Experience building and maintaining data models for reporting and analytics. Ability to independently gather requirements and deliver end-to-end BI solutions. Good to Have Exposure to ETL/ELT tools such as dbt, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer (Airflow). Familiarity with Python for data processing and automation tasks. Experience with other BI tools — Tableau, Power BI, or Data Studio. Understanding of data warehouse concepts and dimensional modelling. Knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for Look ML. GCP Professional Data Engineer or Looker certification (preferred, not mandatory). Education B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience with demonstrable BI portfolio will be considered. What We Offer Opportunity to work on large-scale GCP-native data ecosystems. Exposure to cross-functional stakeholders across product, ops, and leadership. Fast-paced, collaborative environment with room to grow into senior BI or data engineering tracks. Competitive compensation aligned with market benchmarks for Noida / NCR.

title: Technical Project Manager
jobDescription: Job Description – Technical Project Manager Delivery Leadership | Java Spring Boot | Data Platforms | Cloud Job Title Technical Project Manager Experience 10 to 14 Years Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh Work Mode Work from Office (WFO) Employment Type Full-Time Department Technology Delivery / Data Engineering About the Role We are looking for a Technical Project Manager with 10–14 years of experience to lead end-to-end delivery of application and data platform projects. This is a hands-on technical leadership role – the selected candidate will not only own project planning, execution, and stakeholder management, but will also bring strong technical depth in Java / Spring Boot and modern data platforms to guide solution design, conduct technical reviews, and unblock engineering teams. This is a full-time, work-from-office role based in Noida. Key Responsibilities Project Management & Delivery Own end-to-end delivery of application and data projects – planning, estimation, scheduling, resourcing, budgeting, risk management, and stakeholder communication. Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of Java developers, data engineers, BI analysts, and QA across multiple workstreams. Drive Agile/Scrum ceremonies – sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives – and ensure on-time, on-budget, quality delivery. Manage client and senior management relationships; provide regular status reporting, escalation management, and governance reviews. Define project scope, SOWs, and change requests; track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and SLAs. Identify and mitigate technical and delivery risks proactively; manage issue resolution and corrective actions. Technical Leadership Guide solution design for Java / Spring Boot based applications, microservices, and REST APIs that integrate with the data platform. Conduct technical design and code reviews; enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and API/integration design guidelines. Provide technical direction on data platform components – databases, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses/lakehouses, and BI/reporting layers. Review architecture decisions, non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability, availability), and ensure compliance with enterprise standards. Evaluate technologies and tools, and support effort estimation, technical proposals, and RFP responses. Support pre-sales activities – solutioning, client presentations, Po Cs, and technical due diligence. Act as the technical escalation point for delivery teams; help unblock complex design and implementation challenges. Technical Skills Required Java / Spring Boot (Mandatory): Strong knowledge of Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework (Spring Data, Spring Security), microservices architecture, and RESTful API design and development. Experience with application integration patterns, messaging (Kafka/Rabbit MQ), API gateways, and performance tuning of Java applications. Good understanding of modern data platforms – data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures. Hands-on background with relational and analytical databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, Oracle, SQL Server, Big Query, Snowflake). Exposure to at least one major cloud platform – GCP, AWS, or Azure – and its application/data services. Familiarity with big data and lakehouse technologies – Spark, Kafka, Apache Iceberg/Delta Lake, Dremio, Min IO/S3 object storage – is a plus. Working knowledge of Dev Ops practices – Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform. Understanding of BI and analytics tools – Looker, Power BI, Tableau – is an advantage. Proficiency with project management tools – JIRA, MS Project, Confluence – and Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies. Strong grasp of estimation techniques, software delivery lifecycle (SDLC), and quality/security compliance frameworks. Qualifications & Certifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech / MBA). 10–14 years of overall IT experience, with a strong Java / Spring Boot development background and 3–5 years in technical project / delivery management roles. Proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade application and/or data platform projects. Preferred certifications: PMP / PRINCE2 / CSM / SAFe (project management); cloud certifications (GCP/AWS/Azure) are an added advantage. Soft Skills Excellent leadership, team management, and mentoring abilities. Strong client-facing communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Ability to translate business requirements into technical plans and actionable tasks. Strong decision-making, conflict resolution, and escalation management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Work Conditions Location: Noida (Work from Office – 5 days a week). Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to Noida / Delhi NCR.

title: Senior System Analyst - L5
jobDescription: We are seeking a Mainframe Developer with 3–5 years of experience to support development and maintenance of enterprise applications running on mainframe systems. The candidate will be responsible for coding, testing, debugging, and maintaining mainframe programs while ensuring system reliability and performance. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance mainframe applications using COBOL, JCL, and DB2 . Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical design and program specifications . Perform coding, unit testing, debugging, and implementation of applications. Write and modify JCL for batch processing jobs . Work with DB2 databases for data manipulation and query development. Perform program testing, debugging, and defect resolution . Support production issues and perform root cause analysis . Participate in code reviews and documentation . Collaborate with business analysts, testers, and other development teams . Required Skills Strong knowledge of COBOL programming . Experience with JCL (Job Control Language) . Hands-on experience with DB2 or other mainframe databases . Understanding of CICS (Customer Information Control System) . Familiarity with VSAM datasets . Knowledge of mainframe development tools such as TSO/ISPF . Understanding of SDLC and development best practices .
